# **Advanced High-Level Design (HLD)![][image1]**

# **1\. API GATEWAY**

**![][image2]**

## **1.1 Component Summary**

| Aspect | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Component Name | API Gateway |
| Type | Entry Point / Routing Layer |
| Nature | Stateless |
| Primary Role | Request routing & protection |
| Business Logic |  No |

## **1.2 Responsibilities**

| Responsibility | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Request Routing | Routes incoming requests to correct service |
| Authentication | Validates client identity |
| Rate Limiting | Prevents system overload |
| Request Validation | Basic payload checks |

## **1.3 Inputs & Outputs**

| Input | Source | Output | Destination |
| :---- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| HTTP Request | Client | Routed Request | Order / Agent Service |
| Auth Token | Client | Auth Status | Client |

## **1.4 Internal Flow**

| Step | Action |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1\. | Receive client request |
| 2\. | Authenticate & validate |
| 3\. | Apply rate limiting |
| 4\. | Forward to target service |

## **1.5 Failure & Scalability**

| Scenario | Handling |
| ----- | ----- |
| High traffic | Rate limiting |
| Service down | Error response |
| Scaling | Horizontal scaling |

# **2\. ORDER SERVICE**

## **2.1 Component Summary**

| Aspect | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Component Name | Order Service |
| Type | Core Business Service |
| State | Stateless |
| Data Ownership | Orders |
| DB | PostgreSQL (primary), Redis (cache) |

## **2.2 Responsibilities**

| Responsibility | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Order Creation | Create pickup & delivery requests |
| Order Validation | Validate request data |
| Status Management | Track order lifecycle |
| Event Publishing | Publish order events |

## **2.3 Inputs & Outputs**

| Input | Source | Output | Destination |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Create Order Request | API Gateway | OrderCreated Event | Kafka |
| Status Query | Client | Order Status | Client |
| Status Event | Kafka | DB Update | PostgreSQL |

## **2.4 Internal Flow**

| Step | Action |
| ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Receive create order request |
| 2 | Validate payload |
| 3 | Store order in PostgreSQL |
| 4 | Cache status in Redis |
| 5 | Publish OrderCreated event |

## **2.5 Failure & Scalability**

| Scenario | Handling |
| ----- | ----- |
| DB failure | Retry / error response |
| High reads | Redis cache |
| Scaling | Horizontal |

# **3\. SCHEDULER SERVICE**

**![][image3]**

## **3.1 Component Summary**

| Aspect | Description |
| :---- | :---- |
| Component Name | Scheduler Service |
| Type | Decision Engine |
| State | Stateless |
| Core Function | Task assignment |
| Data Access | Redis \+ PostgreSQL |

## **3.2 Responsibilities**

| Responsibility | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Event Consumption | Listen to OrderCreated |
| Agent Selection | Choose best available agent |
| Assignment Creation | Create task assignments |
| Retry Handling | Reassign on failure |

## **3.3 Inputs & Outputs**

| Input | Source | Output | Destination |
| :---- | ----- | :---- | :---- |
| OrderCreated Event | Kafka | TaskAssigned Event | Kafka |
| Agent Availability | Redis | Assignment Record | PostgreSQL |

## **3.4 Internal Flow**

| Step | Action |
| ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Consume OrderCreated event |
| 2 | Fetch agent availability |
| 3 | Filter eligible agents |
| 4 | Apply scheduling logic |
| 5 | Create assignment |
| 6 | Publish TaskAssigned event |

## **3.5 Failure & Scalability**

| Scenario | Handling |
| ----- | ----- |
| Agent unavailable | Retry assignment |
| Event duplication | Idempotent logic |
| High load | Parallel consumers |

# **4\. AGENT SERVICE** 

**![][image4]**

## **4.1 Component Summary**

| Aspect | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Component Name | Agent Service |
| Type | Operational Service |
| State | Stateless |
| Ownership | Agent lifecycle |

## **4.2 Responsibilities**

| Responsibility | Description |
| ----- | ----- |
| Agent Availability | Track agent status |
| Task Delivery | Push tasks to agents |
| Status Updates | Emit delivery events |

## **4.3 Inputs & Outputs**

| Input | Source | Output | Destination |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| TaskAssigned Event | Kafka | Status Events | Kafka |
| Agent Response | Agent App | Availability Update | Redis |

## **4.4 Internal Flow**

| Step | Action |
| ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Consume TaskAssigned |
| 2 | Notify agent |
| 3 | Track delivery |
| 4 | Publish status events |

# **5\. DATA LAYER – ADVANCED HLD**

**![][image5]**

## **5.1 Storage Strategy**

| Layer | Purpose |
| ----- | ----- |
| PostgreSQL | Source of truth |
| Redis | Fast access & availability |

## **5.2 Data Ownership**

| Data | Owner |
| ----- | ----- |
| Orders | Order Service |
| Assignments | Scheduler Service |
| Agent Status | Agent Service |

# **6\. KAFKA / MESSAGING**

**![][image6]**

## **6.1 Event Design**

| Event | Producer | Consumer |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| OrderCreated | Order Service | Scheduler |
| TaskAssigned | Scheduler | Agent Service |
| StatusUpdated | Agent Service | Order Service |

## **6.2 Messaging Guarantees**

| Aspect | Choice |
| ----- | ----- |
| Delivery | At-least-once |
| Ordering | Per partition |
| Fault tolerance | High |
